faq.title: Good to know before you begin.

items.question: What is easyParking?
items.answer: easyParking is a parking management application for organizing members, vehicles, monthly subscriptions, dues, payments, daily parking and reports.

items.question: Who can use easyParking?
items.answer: It is designed for parking owners and their Managers who need a straightforward way to maintain parking records.

items.question: Can one member have multiple vehicles?
items.answer: Yes. A member can have multiple vehicles, and each vehicle has its own monthly subscription and billing history.

items.question: Can I manage monthly and daily parking?
items.answer: Yes. Monthly subscriptions and walk-in daily parking are tracked in separate workflows.

items.question: Can I record partial payments?
items.answer: Yes. A payment can be partial or allocated across multiple outstanding monthly dues. Daily parking payments are recorded separately.

items.question: Can multiple users access the same parking?
items.answer: An Owner can invite a Manager. Owners approve payment correction requests; Managers can request them.

items.question: Does easyParking support Urdu?
items.answer: Yes. The interface supports Urdu, Iranian Persian, English and Roman Urdu. Urdu and Persian use right-to-left layouts.

items.question: Can I use it on my mobile phone?
items.answer: Yes. The application is responsive and installable as a Progressive Web App on supported devices. It needs an internet connection for records and changes.

items.question: Is my parking data private?
items.answer: Parking records are scoped to a parking workspace, and the API checks the signed-in user's active membership before serving parking data. Ask your parking Owner about the service's hosting and retention policies.

legal.privacyIntro: This product overview describes the information easyParking handles in its current workflows. It is not a complete service-provider privacy policy.
legal.privacyData: Accounts can include a name, email or phone number and language preference. Parking workspaces can include member contact details, vehicle information, subscription records, dues, payments and daily parking entries.
legal.privacyAccess: Parking records are associated with a parking workspace. The API checks for an active membership before serving workspace data. Owners and Managers have different permissions for invitations and payment corrections.
legal.privacyLimits: The service operator, hosting location, retention schedule, support contact and data-rights process have not been provided in the product materials. Ask your parking Owner for the applicable service policy before entering personal information.
legal.termsIntro: These notes summarize the product's intended use; they are not a complete legal agreement.
legal.termsUse: Use easyParking only with an account and parking workspace you are authorized to access. Owners manage invitations; Managers can work with parking records but cannot approve payment corrections.
legal.termsRecords: easyParking records information entered by its users. Check member, vehicle, billing and payment details for accuracy. Payments are manually recorded; the application does not process online payments.
legal.termsLimits: Pricing, service availability, support, jurisdiction and other legal terms have not been provided. Contact the service operator through your parking Owner for the applicable agreement.
